# `UnsafeOperationException`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\OpenApi\Exception\UnsafeOperationException`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/OpenApi/Exception/UnsafeOperationException.php) — **Extends:** `LogicException`

An allow-listed operation uses a non-GET HTTP method while the bridge is
configured with `safe_methods_only` — a wiring mistake that must fail
fast at server build time instead of exposing a write operation.

No public properties or methods beyond the constructor.
